description: This Java source file defines the TaxRatesController class, which manages CRUD operations and UI interactions for tax rate management within an admin panel using Spring MVC framework. It handles listing, adding, updating, and removing tax rates, as well as rendering views related to tax rates.

classes.name: TaxRatesController
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax rate operations in the admin interface, including listing, saving, updating, removing, and editing tax rates.

methods.name: displayTaxRates
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of tax rates and related data for the admin UI.

methods.name: pageTaxRates
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch paginated tax rate data in JSON format for the UI.

methods.name: saveTaxRate
methods.description: Processes POST form submission to create a new tax rate after validation.

methods.name: updateTaxRate
methods.description: Processes POST form submission to update an existing tax rate after validation.

methods.name: validateTaxRate
methods.description: Validates the tax rate object, checking for required fields, unique code, and proper formatting.

methods.name: removeTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a tax rate by ID, returning JSON status.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Handles GET request to load the tax rate edit page, pre-filling existing data.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu attributes for rendering the UI navigation.
